scenario.name: 03 - Automated Outreach: Email Follow-Up Sequence
scenario.description: Manages the multi-step email outreach sequence. Checks daily for leads that need follow-up emails (Follow-Up 1 at day 3, Follow-Up 2 at day 8). Stops sequence if lead books a call or replies.

scheduling.note: Runs every morning at 9 AM to send follow-ups

modules.name: Airtable - Search Records
modules.description: Find leads due for follow-up emails

config.filterFormula: AND(OR({Lead Status} = 'Contacted', {Lead Status} = 'Qualified'), {Outreach Sequence Step} < 3, IS_BEFORE({Follow Up Date}, DATEADD(NOW(), 1, 'days')))

modules.name: Iterator
modules.description: Process each lead that needs a follow-up

modules.name: Router
modules.description: Route based on current sequence step

routes.name: Send Follow-Up #1
routes.description: 3 days after initial outreach, send first follow-up

routes.name: Send Follow-Up #2 (Final)
routes.description: 5 days after Follow-Up #1, send final follow-up

modules.name: Gmail - Send Email (Follow-Up #1)
modules.description: Send first follow-up email with social proof

config.subject: Quick follow-up on your podcast inquiry, {{1.Full Name}}

followedBy.name: Airtable - Update Record
followedBy.description: Advance sequence step and set next follow-up date

modules.name: Gmail - Send Email (Follow-Up #2)
modules.description: Send final follow-up email with free resources

config.subject: Last check-in — still interested in podcasting, {{1.Full Name}}?

followedBy.name: Airtable - Update Record
followedBy.description: Mark sequence as complete, move to nurture if no response

followedBy.name: Google Sheets - Update Row
followedBy.description: Update email tracking and status in Sheets

sequence_timeline.day_0_to_1: Lead qualified and scored (Scenario 02) → Initial outreach sent
sequence_timeline.day_3: Follow-Up #1 sent (this scenario) — includes testimonial/social proof
sequence_timeline.day_8: Follow-Up #2 sent (this scenario) — final email with free resources
sequence_timeline.day_8_plus: If no response → Status changes to 'Nurture'. Monthly check-in optional.
sequence_timeline.anytime: If lead books a call → Sequence stops, status changes to 'Discovery Call Scheduled' (Scenario 04)

setup_instructions: 1. Create this as a scheduled scenario in Make.com, running daily at 9 AM
2. Connect to the same Airtable base
3. Configure the filter formula to find leads due for follow-up
5. Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_CALENDAR_APPOINTMENT_URL with your actual booking link
6. Test with a lead that has Outreach Sequence Step = 1 and a past Follow Up Date
